experiment: E6: Survey benchmark - standardised comparison of 7 DRL algorithms (bench_env_v5)

environment.name: bench_env_v5
environment.base: SiliQunEnv: device=simos, n_qubits=2, target=ghz, sim_mode=sv (exact state vector), noise_enabled=true (Lindblad), reward_type=shaped
environment.action_space: Discrete(7): 6 single-qubit rotations (RX/RY/RZ pi/2 on q0/q1) + CNOT(0->1)

eval_protocol: 10 held-out episodes per eval point, deterministic policy, rotating noise seeds 12345..12354, 20-gate cap per episode; metric = mean best fidelity over the 10 episodes (episodes terminate at F >= 0.99). The 20-gate cap was fixed after protocol validation: with the original 200-gate cap a random policy reaches best F >= 0.99 in 92.5% of episodes (per-depth analysis, results/e6_random_baseline_per_depth.json), which destroys the solve metric. At the 20-gate cap the random floor is mean 0.621 (25% of episodes >= 0.99, results/e6_random_baseline.json).
failure_criterion: final mean held-out F < 0.75 (between the random 20-gate floor ~0.64 and the solve threshold 0.99; degenerate fixed-gate policies plateau ~0.25-0.50)

variants.dqn_nas: SB3 DQN, MlpPolicy [512,512,512] (wider architecture stand-in for the NAS-extended variant)
variants.ppo_hier: SB3 PPO (base hyperparameters) on BenchHistoryEnv: observation + one-hot of last 2 actions (flat temporal abstraction)
variants.sac: SB3 SAC, MlpPolicy [256,256] (temperature always learned, SB3 default) on BenchRelaxationEnv: this SB3 build's SAC only supports Box action spaces, so it shares the DDPG row's Box(7,) continuous relaxation (argmax gate selection); SAC adds the stochastic squashed-Gaussian policy + max-entropy objective
variants.ddpg: SB3 DDPG, MlpPolicy [256,256] on BenchRelaxationEnv (Box(7,) logits, argmax)

notes: Reconstruction of the survey Section-12 benchmark (original bench_env_v5 code was hosted in the removed quasar-v6 repository). Shared hyperparameters match experiments/E2_replication_he/config_e2.json. Hardware: local RTX 5090 laptop (CPU-only NumPy/CuPy-free SiliQun backend; torch CPU for policies).
